bio: A goat kid in a sweater holding a floppy disk like a leaf. It jumped over a chair once and has been dining out on it since.
A window on its flank shows whatever it wants you to see. It bleats a startup chime and asks you to restart.
Its horns are screens, and the bleat is a chime everyone on earth has heard. It sells the same window to every desk, every three years.
It owns the field it stands in, and the next one. Furrows for fur, a tractor tyre for a collar, and a plan for the whole county.
note: Reads a book a week and tells you about it.
Its windows freeze now and then. It calls this an opportunity.
Gives away more than most Billies make, and keeps the receipts.
Nobody has counted its acres. It has.
